findings.location: Al-Bureij refugee camp, central Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Palestinian civilians; two reported fatalities and several injuries (unspecified count) attributed to an Israeli airstrike
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Two Palestinians were killed and several others injured on Friday evening in an Israeli airstrike targeting Al-Bureij refugee camp
findings.source_type: Palestinian public news agency; correspondent attributing casualty count to medical sources
findings.finding_summary: WAFA reported two Palestinians killed and several others injured in an Israeli airstrike on Al-Bureij refugee camp on Friday evening, 20 November 2026. Medical-source reporting was not independently corroborated. The article's total of five Gaza deaths since morning is a daily aggregate and must not be added as additional casualties.
